N.Y.C. minus WEST widens by $55/MWh for 30 days (pocket_minus_ref_usd +55) on a persistent Zone J constraint, the main loss driver through P5, with the 25 MW long spread P2 offsetting part. The WEST on-peak price eases a further 35% (ref_onpeak_pct -35) on upstate surplus, and Henry Hub falls 10% (gas_hh_pct -10); both reduce the long P1 swap and the P4 call. Day-ahead/real-time, gas basis and spike shocks are zero. Estimate: P5 about -$5.5M, P2 about +$1.0M, P1 about -$1.5M, P4 about -$0.5M, total about -$6.5M. This is extrapolated from earlier engine results, so uncertain.
